repos_data.description: Speedtest Tracker is a self-hosted application that monitors the performance and uptime of your internet connection.
Command line interface for testing internet bandwidth using speedtest.net
A speed test analysis software that shows your internet speed for up to 30 days

repo_meta_data.description: SpeedTest by OpenSpeedTest™ is a Free and Open-Source HTML5 Network Performance Estimation Tool Written in Vanilla Javascript and only uses built-in Web APIs like XMLHttpRequest (XHR), HTML, CSS, JS, & SVG. No Third-Party frameworks or libraries are Required. Started in 2011 and moved to OpenSpeedTest.com dedicated Project/Domain Name in 2013.
